explanation: This message has characteristics commonly associated with cashback and lottery scams in India. It offers an unsolicited ₹50,000 cashback supposedly from Paytm, then asks for a ₹499 'processing fee' — a classic advance-fee pattern. The link uses a .xyz domain that mimics Paytm but is not affiliated with the company. While the URL was not found in current threat-intelligence feeds, multiple rule-based and ML signals flag it as suspicious.
next_steps: Do NOT pay any 'processing fee' or share personal details.
Do NOT click the link — it is not an official Paytm domain.
Verify directly: open the official Paytm app or visit paytm.com to check for any real offers.
Report: call 1930 (Cyber Crime Helpline) or file a complaint at https://cybercrime.gov.in
